title: Last breakfast · last Donki haul · depachika gifts · tax-free kiosk · fly home from Haneda

stops.name: Check out Garfield House
stops.plan: Out with carry-ons only (the suitcases went to Haneda T3 by Yamato on Dec 27); passports and every tax-free receipt in hand luggage.
stops.transport: Walk to Shinjuku-sanchome, Toei Shinjuku line → Shinjuku (1 stop), walk through the West Exit; about 27 min door to door

stops.name: Shinpachi Shokudo Nishi-Shinjuku
stops.plan: Last Japanese breakfast: charcoal-grilled fish set with rice and miso, quick and cheap; split across 2–3 tables.
stops.transport: Walk 9 min east through Shinjuku Station to the East Exit

stops.name: MEGA Don Quijote Shinjuku Higashiguchi
stops.plan: The final Donki run: KitKats, skincare, snacks; each person pays on their own passport, ¥5,000+ ex-tax on one receipt, and keeps it all in the carry-on for the T3 kiosk.
stops.transport: Walk 5 min along Shinjuku-dori to Isetan

stops.name: Isetan Shinjuku depachika
stops.plan: Boxed sweets and senbei to take home from the basement food hall (busy with New Year shoppers); split up, meet on the ground floor.
stops.transport: Tokyo Metro Marunouchi line Shinjuku-sanchome → Akasaka-mitsuke, Ginza line → Shimbashi, Toei Asakusa line → Sengakuji and straight on by Keikyu Airport Limited Express to Haneda Airport Terminal 3; about 60 min door to door (¥650, IC card)

stops.name: Haneda T3 Edo Market Place (Edo Koji)
stops.plan: A last bowl of ramen or soba on the 4th-floor Edo street before the paperwork; first collect the suitcases from the airport-delivery counter on the Yamato slip.
stops.transport: Walk 1 min to the customs tax-free kiosk

stops.name: Tax-free refund customs kiosk (Haneda T3)
stops.plan: Before bag drop: each person scans passport and receipts with every refundable item to hand (one missing item voids that whole receipt), then packs it all into the checked bag.
stops.transport: Walk 1 min to the airline counters

stops.name: Airline bag drop (T3)
stops.plan: Drop the suitcases at the airline counter; 29 Dec is a peak departure day.
stops.transport: Walk to the departures security entrance

stops.name: Security and passport control (T3)
stops.plan: Through security and immigration together, then airside duty-free and the gate.
